metadata.title: About RealtyHub
metadata.description: RealtyHub is the technology platform built for real estate agents — providing project information, a centralized unit inventory (especially in the South) and a dedicated sales toolkit.

hero.headline: A TECHNOLOGY PLATFORM BUILT FOR REAL ESTATE AGENTS
hero.lead: RealtyHub combines data, AI and sales technology in one platform built for agents — optimizing every consultation step and elevating transaction performance.

intro.title: ONE PLATFORM – ALL THE TOOLS YOU NEED TO BOOST SALES
intro.body: More than a place to look up information, RealtyHub provides a toolkit designed for each step of the real-estate sales process — from product discovery to consulting, customer care and deal tracking.
